narrative: 用它来做端详式的审视。一件外套、一瓶酒、一件武器，或一个被当作商品来处理的人物：所有方位都在不剪辑的情况下依次呈现。
灯光应保持一致，让发生变化的是物体本身，而不是房间。如果空间关系很重要，这就不是合适的工具。
如果墙壁、群众演员和灯具需要滑动，以证明这是一个真实存在的空间，那你想要的其实是环绕镜头（Orbit）。一场对话、一次追逐、一间需要走位调度的房间：这些都需要摄影机真正移动。
how: 经典的装置是主体下方的一个电动转盘；摄影机固定在三脚架上，高度设在视平或产品高度，通常使用50到85mm镜头以保持轮廓干净利落。另一种方式：用一条恒定半径的环形滑轨，让主体保持固定。
无论哪种方式，节点距离都保持不变。提示词：缓慢的转盘旋转，或摄影机以产品展示距离环绕主体，完成一整圈或90度的展示，不使用变焦。
when: 从各个角度展示一件物体或一套服装：人体模型上的裙子、影棚背景前的汽车、玻璃展台上的文物。不要把它用在对话中；对话中的脸不需要旋转。
vs: 360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）让摄影机在一个真实的空间中环绕移动，使墙壁和群众演员产生剪切滑动。转盘拍摄则保持恒定半径，通常房间是静止的。
3D旋转（3D Rotation）把人物当作计算空间中的一尊虚拟雕塑来处理。弧形运镜（Arc）则是一段部分圆弧，依然是在真实房间中面对一个人。
examples_film: 产品广告和音乐录影带中的服装旋转展示是这种语法的代表：香水转盘、专辑封面式的旋转、作为标本展示的主打道具。这些都是审视性的用法，而不是叙事性的街道环绕。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是环绕镜头。破绽在于：背景在滑动，灯具产生剪切，房间本身在旋转。
解决办法：锁定摄影机，或把主体固定在转盘上，保持半径恒定，只让物体本身旋转。

faq.q: 电影中的转盘拍摄（Lazy Susan）是什么？
faq.a: 转盘拍摄是让主体在转盘上旋转、摄影机保持锁定，或者摄影机以固定的产品展示距离环绕物体，使各个侧面都能在画面大小不变的情况下依次呈现。

faq.q: 转盘拍摄（Lazy Susan）与360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）的区别
faq.a: 环绕镜头让摄影机在真实的房间中移动，墙壁和群众演员产生的视差就是证明。转盘拍摄则保持半径不变，背景通常静止不动；物体像标本一样自行旋转。

faq.q: 什么时候该用转盘拍摄（Lazy Susan）？
faq.a: 用它从各个角度展示一件服装、产品或文物。当场景空间本身需要发挥作用时，就跳过它，改用环绕镜头或弧形运镜。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写转盘拍摄（Lazy Susan）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明转盘旋转，或摄影机以产品展示距离环绕。说明物体是什么，保持距离不变，并注明不使用变焦。示例：Lazy-Susan rotation of [Subject] on a turntable while the camera stays put.

narrative: Use it to inspect. A coat, a bottle, a weapon, a figure treated as merchandise: every azimuth is offered without a cut.
Light should stay consistent so the object, not the room, is what changes. It is the wrong tool when geography matters.
If walls, extras, and lamps must slide to prove a living space, you want an orbit. A conversation, a chase, a blocked room: those need the camera to travel.
how: The classic rig is a motorized disc under the subject; the camera is locked on sticks at eye or product height, often 50 to 85mm so the silhouette stays clean. Alternate: a circular slider at constant radius with the subject locked.
Either way, nodal distance is constant. Prompt a slow turntable rotation or a camera circling at product-hero distance, one revolution or a 90-degree reveal, no zoom.
when: Show an object or costume from every side: a dress on a dummy, a car on a cyc, a relic on glass. Do not use it for a talk; faces in dialogue do not need a spin.
vs: 360-Degree Orbit walks the camera around a living space so walls and extras shear. A lazy susan keeps radius and usually the room still.
3D Rotation treats the figure as a virtual sculpture in computed space. An Arc is a partial circle that still faces a person in a real room.
examples_film: Product films and music-video costume spins are the grammar: perfume turntables, album-cover rotations, a hero prop shown as a specimen. These are inspection uses, not a narrative street orbit.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is an orbit. The tell: background sliding, a lamp shearing, the room turning.
The fix: lock the camera or lock the subject to a disc, keep radius constant, let only the object rotate.

faq.q: What is Lazy Susan in film?
faq.a: A lazy susan shot rotates the subject on a turntable with the camera locked, or circles the object at a fixed product-hero distance, so every side is shown without a change in scale.
An orbit moves the camera through a real room so parallax of walls and extras is the proof. A lazy susan keeps the radius and usually the background still; the object turns like a specimen.

faq.q: When should I use Lazy Susan?
faq.a: Use it to show a costume, product, or relic from every side. Skip it when the location has to act; then orbit or arc instead.

faq.q: How do I prompt Lazy Susan for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write a turntable rotation or a camera circling at product-hero distance. Name the object, hold distance, and say no zoom. Example: Lazy-Susan rotation of [Subject] on a turntable while the camera stays put.
